note: DRAFT / BETA-UNVERIFIED. Not reviewed, not approved. Assistant-drafted in the popular register from the Urdu translation of Maulana Muhammad Junagarhi; ships only behind a visible Beta label until human review. House style: popular; see docs/decisions/0004-roman-urdu-working-style.md.

ayahs.1: (Ae Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aap keh den ke mujhe wahi ki gayi hai ke jinnon ki ek jamaat ne (Quran) suna aur kaha ke hum ne ajeeb Quran suna hai.
ayahs.2: Jo raah-e-raast ki taraf rehnumaai karta hai. Hum us par imaan la chuke (ab) hum hargiz kisi ko bhi apne Rabb ka shareek na banaenge.
ayahs.3: Aur beshak hamare Rabb ki shaan badi buland hai, na us ne kisi ko (apni) biwi banaya hai na beta.
ayahs.4: Aur yeh ke hum mein se bewaqoof [yani Iblees] Allah ke baare mein khilaaf-e-haq baatein kaha karta tha.
ayahs.5: Aur hum to yehi samajhte rahe ke na-mumkin hai ke insaanon aur jinnaat Allah par jhoothi baatein lagaen.
ayahs.6: Baat yeh hai ke chand insaan baaz jinnaat se panaah talab kiya karte the jis se jinnaat apni sarkashi mein aur badh gaye.
ayahs.7: Aur (insaanon) ne bhi tum jinnon ki tarah guman kar liya tha ke Allah kisi ko na bhejega (ya kisi ko dobara zinda na karega).
ayahs.8: Aur hum ne aasman ko tatol kar dekha to use sakht chowkidaron aur sakht sholon se pur paya.
ayahs.9: Is se pehle hum baatein sunne ke liye aasman mein jagah jagah baith jaya karte the. Ab jo bhi kaan lagaata hai woh ek shole ko apni taak mein paata hai.
ayahs.10: Hum nahin jaante ke zameen walon ke saath kisi buraai ka iraada kiya gaya hai ya un ke Rabb ka iraada un ke saath bhalaai ka hai.
ayahs.11: Aur yeh ke (beshak) baaz to hum mein neko-kaar hain aur baaz is ke barakas bhi hain, hum mukhtalif tareeqon se bate hue hain.
ayahs.12: Aur hum ne samajh liya ke hum Allah Taala ko zameen mein hargiz aajiz nahin kar sakte aur na hum bhaag kar use hara sakte hain.
ayahs.13: Hum to hidayat ki baat sunte hi us par imaan laa chuke aur jo bhi apne Rabb par imaan laayega use na kisi nuqsan ka andesha hai na zulm-o-sitam ka.
ayahs.14: Haan hum mein baaz to musalman hain aur baaz be-insaaf hain, pas jo farmaanbardaar ho gaye unhon ne to raah-e-raast ka qasd kiya.
ayahs.15: Aur jo zaalim hain woh jahannam ka indhan ban gaye.
ayahs.16: Aur (ae Nabi yeh bhi keh do) ke agar log raah-e-raast par seedhe rehte to yaqeenan hum unhein bahut waafir paani pilaate.
ayahs.17: Taake hum is mein unhein aazmaen, aur jo shakhs apne Parwardigaar ke zikr se munh pher lega to Allah Taala use sakht azaab mein mubtala kar dega.
ayahs.18: Aur yeh ke masjiden sirf Allah hi ke liye khaas hain, pas Allah Taala ke saath kisi aur ko na pukaro.
ayahs.19: Aur jab Allah ka banda us ki ibaadat ke liye khada hua to qareeb tha ke woh bheed ki bheed ban kar us par pal padein.
ayahs.20: Aap keh dijiye ke main to sirf apne Rabb hi ko pukaarta hoon aur us ke saath kisi ko shareek nahin karta.
ayahs.21: Keh dijiye ke mujhe tumhare kisi nuqsan nafe ka ikhtiyar nahin.
ayahs.22: Keh dijiye ke mujhe hargiz koi Allah se bacha nahin sakta aur main hargiz us ke siwa koi jaa-e-panaah bhi pa nahin sakta.
ayahs.23: Albatta (mera kaam) Allah ki baat aur us ke paighamaat (logon ko) pahuncha dena hai, (ab) jo bhi Allah aur us ke Rasool ki na maanega us ke liye jahannam ki aag hai jis mein aise log hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.24: (Un ki aankh na khulegi) yahan tak ke use dekh len jis ka un ko waada diya jaata hai, pas anqareeb jaan lenge ke kis ka madadgaar kamzor aur kis ki jamaat kam hai.
ayahs.25: Keh dijiye ke mujhe maloom nahin ke jis ka waada tum se kiya jaata hai woh qareeb hai ya mera Rabb us ke liye door ki muddat muqarrar karega.
ayahs.26: Woh ghaib ka jaanne wala hai aur apne ghaib par kisi ko muttale nahin karta.
ayahs.27: Siwaye us paighambar ke jise woh pasand kar le, lekin us ke bhi aage peechhe pehredaar muqarrar kar deta hai.
ayahs.28: Taake un ke apne Rabb ke paighaam pahuncha dene ka ilm ho jaaye. Allah Taala ne un ke aas paas (ki tamaam cheezon) ka ehaata kar rakha hai aur har cheez ki ginti shumaar kar rakha hai.
